question: The walls are 1 and 7 high. Which builder should step inward?
context: The widest barrel uses planks of height 1 (left) and 7 (right) and holds 1 × 8 = 8.

choices.label: The left builder, at the 1-high plank
choices.feedback: Right. Water can never rise above 1 while that plank is a wall, and every other barrel with it is narrower, so it can only hold less.

choices.label: The right builder, at the 7-high plank
choices.feedback: Moving the taller wall keeps the 1-high plank, so the water stays at most 1 while the barrel gets narrower. That can only lose water.

choices.label: Both builders together
choices.feedback: That would skip pairs that use the 7-high plank with planks further left, such as the 8 at position 1. Move only the shorter wall.
